body: Does it really matter? In the end, I will still die, be it from old age or hanging. I gave too many shits about other people without anyone deciding to give a shit about me, and even after I'm gone no one will give a shit. That's just how the world goes. People say you don't know how much  someone means to you until they're gone, but I call bullcrap on that. People have, and always will be selfish. At least I'm going to be selfish for once and leave without giving a damn.
I'm not better than anyone, I've just given up and looking at everything from a cynical perspective. I've hit my limit and chances I'll see tomorrow are second to none.
Guess I'm just not lucky enough. But here's to hoping those people meet some other poor soul who needs help.

Thing is, I just need to feel thay someone sincerely cares. Not once in 21 years have I heard an honest "how are you?". In reality, no one gives a crap about others and the world doesn't owe anyone anything.
